board: Seeed Grove - Touch Sensor (TTP223-BA6), 4-pin Grove connector SIG, NC, VCC, GND

breakoutPinoutSource: Board silkscreen GND, VCC, NC, SIG in https://files.seeedstudio.com/wiki/Grove-Touch_Sensor/img/surface.jpg (Seeed wiki https://wiki.seeedstudio.com/Grove-Touch_Sensor/), listed in Grove order pin 1 SIG to pin 4 GND
